title: These work!
text: These work!. I had pantry moths flying all over. These eek-o premium pantry moth traps have helped tremendously.  I followed the directions and set them out in my pantry and the kitchen. At first I didn’t notice very many moths in the traps and there were plenty of them flying around. About a month to six weeks later I checked the traps and there were a lot more moths caught in the traps.  I haven’t seen any pantry moths flying around for months.

product_metadata.title: eek-o Premium Pantry Moth Trap 20 Pack | Responsibly Designed | with Pheromones | Use to Monitor Kitchen Pantry Moth Infestations | Vented Design with 25% More Airflow Spreads Pheromone Evenly[1]
features: FINALLY, A PREMIUM MOTH TRAP, DESIGNED FOR YOUR MODERN HOME: The eek-o Premium Pantry Moth Trap with pheromone makes monitoring pantry moths at home a breeze. Its unique vented design increases airflow capacity by 25%, allowing pheromone to spread more evenly[1].

AND IT LOOKS GREAT TOO! You don't live in a factory, and you shouldn't have to settle for industrial-looking products anywhere in your home. You deserve great-looking, responsibly-designed products even if they're inside your pantry.

USE AND RECYCLE: Made with recycled cardboard, the eek-o Premium Pantry Moth Trap is designed for responsible disposal and recycling. We cherish the earth's resources and are dedicated to reduce, reuse, and recycle in every aspect of our business. All of our products embody this ethos.

FIVE STEPS TO MANAGING PANTRY MOTHS: 1) Order a supply of eek-o Pantry Moth Traps. 2) Check your pantry food supply disposing of anything showing signs of moth activity. Moths like flours, grains, cereals, and sometimes dried fruits, so make a careful inspection of all your dry goods, including birdseed and pet foods. 3) Clean your pantry shelving and all exposed surfaces. 4) securely seal all the foods moths like. 5) Place eek-o Pantry Moth Traps around your pantry to monitor moth activity.

ONLY FOR USE WITH PANTRY MOTHS: Moths attracted to the food in your pantry are a unique species. Their scientific name is "Plodia interpunctella," but they are commonly referred to with names like Meal Moths, Weevil Moths, Flour Moths, or Grain Moths. The eek-o Premium Pantry Moth Trap is designed to attract only this moth species. It is not useful for use with other moths such as Clothing Moths or Gypsy Moths.
description: If you see a moth in your pantry, it is most likely a Meal Moth; they’re the world’s most common household moths, and they like to eat some of the same things you do. On their life-cycle journey, moths arrive, lay eggs, and larvae emerge to ruin your food. What a waste! With its unique vented design adding 25% More Airflow[1], the eek-o Premium Pantry Moth Trap[2] spreads pheromone evenly. It makes monitoring the food in your pantry for moth infestations is a breeze! [NOTES] 1. eek-o’s unique vented design adds perforations to the trap structure, opening 25% more surface area to airflow. The additional open space allows the movement of a greater volume of air through the trap than would otherwise be the case resulting in a more even pheromone diffusion. 2. the eek-o Premium Pantry Moth Trap is exempt from EPA registration requirements and all provisions of the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA) as per Section 40 CFR 152.25, subsections (b), and (b)(4).
